svg.text: forwards a voice note to translate it,
records a voice note to reply
The student is already a member.
📝 Summary: last N messages → spoken-style briefing, as text + voice note
🌐 Translate: last N messages line by line, keeping who said what and when
🎙️ Forwarded voice note: transcribe → translate → voice note in the student's language
🗣️ Reply: student's voice → Italian text + voice → ✅ confirm → posted to the group
→ OGG/Opus, sent as a Telegram voice note (no ffmpeg)
Audio summary, forwarded voice notes, reply in Italian
The student talks to the bot in private; the bot reads the groups through the student's own account.
Secrets live in .env, the Telegram login in user.session. Neither is committed.
